findings.title: No application-layer maximum replay size bound
evidence: REPLAY_STORE_MAX_CONCURRENT/QUEUED bound concurrency, not object size
findings.impact: A large-but-valid ghost could inflate storage/compute cost; the bound today is the storage provider's bucket policy, not the app.
findings.recommendation: Reject ghosts above a documented byte ceiling at admission, with a test, and reflect it in the bucket policy.

report: Replay object store reviewed: content-addressed keys, upload read-back checksum verification, per-read download checksum, expiry-bound signed URLs (300s) with policy re-evaluated on every access, and a 4/64 concurrency/queue limiter (replayStore.ts:1-130). Residual: the application does not enforce a maximum replay byte size; it relies on the storage/RPC path and the bucket policy.
